title: System Fair TOBB Review Audit Actions

items.action: audit a Super Admin TOBB proposal decision
audit correction of a TOBB identity mapping without moving tenant data

frontend.reason: The audit action is written by the merge service. The fairs page contract covers the review UI.

database.reason: The audit row uses the existing audit store. No new product table is added here.

migration.reason: No schema change belongs to the audit action itself.

api.reason: The HTTP routes stay on the duplicate-merge contract and still use the Super Admin gate.

tenant_isolation.reason: The action is system-scoped. Organization fairs are rejected by the merge service.

frontend.reason: No screen is added for the audit action.

ui_permissions.reason: The review UI stays on the existing Super Admin flag.

route_guard.reason: No route guard changes with the audit action.

forms.reason: No form is added for the audit action.

visual_qa.reason: The audit action has no visible surface.

frontend_tests.reason: The audit action has no frontend behavior.

deployment.reason: Declaring the audit action does not change the deploy path.

notes: ADR-040: TOBB review decisions and mapping corrections record existing Core audit events fair_crm.tobb.review_decided and fair_crm.tobb.mapping_changed. These are audit action codes, not route permission guards; system scope, not role-assignable. API authorization remains the existing Core DB Super Admin flag. Audit records include actor, compared fields, chosen target/source edition and system-scope metadata. No tenant relationships are moved and no second audit store is created. Real Core audit writes and ordinary-admin denials are required acceptance evidence.
